title: Serve five complete European raw UI banks
changes: Preserve and serve the previously missing prefixes of five source-bounded localized raw banks, retaining existing resource owners and original guest transfers.
validation: Wine qa7y9h7g validates all 4,480 bank bytes, mixed boundaries and 30 original interpreted and generated transfer cases; Wine 4j2h1iqg validates production CLI create, reuse and verify. Both servers drained.
limitations: The selector tables remain ROM-backed for these cases; ordinary use, unrestricted indices, other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows are pending. No performance comparison was made.
